events.title: Tupac Shakur: Would Have Been 55
events.blurb: On September 7th, 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by in Las Vegas, passing away six days later on September 13th, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a voice that defined a generation. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Would Have Been 84
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, a true innovator who redefined the electric guitar. His music still sounds as fresh and electrifying today.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like "Come Together" and "Here Comes the Sun".

angles.name: Album Artwork
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album turns 57, and its cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce stage presence continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for It
angles.copy: Another year older, still as rock 'n' roll as ever. Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher!

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album: 55 Years On
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on October 8, 1971, featuring the iconic title track.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: More than just an album, 'Imagine' is a message that still resonates today. John Lennon's masterpiece turns 55.

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years Since Launch
events.blurb: On October 23, 2001, Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The original iPod celebrates its 25th anniversary, a true game-changer for music lovers.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years of 007's enduring style, gadgets, and thrilling adventures.

events.title: John Lennon: Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: A Voice for Peace
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon – a visionary artist whose message of peace continues to resonate.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us decades of iconic laughter. Happy 87th Birthday to a true comedy legend!

events.title: The Beatles' White Album: 58 Years On
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58, a sprawling and experimental masterpiece that showcased the band's incredible range.

events.title: Freddie Mercury: Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury on the 35th anniversary of his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul: 61 Years Old
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: A New Direction
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles took a bold new direction with 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game.
